exposure: Childbirth simulation tool (PREDIBIRTH software and SIM37 platform)
cohort: Patients referred for MRI pelvimetry at approximately 37 weeks of gestation
finding: Using a childbirth simulation tool to predict optimal delivery mode has the potential to reduce emergency cesarean sections, inappropriately scheduled cesarean sections, and instrumental vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: This study suggests that a childbirth simulation tool has the potential to reduce emergency and unnecessary c-sections, as well as instrumental vaginal deliveries, ultimately influencing the decision-making process for mode of delivery.
